demo_must_show: OAuth consent flow for Locality with all visible requested permissions expanded and readable.
Mailbox projection after connecting and pulling Gmail.
Opening an inbox or sent message to show Locality reads full message content, not only metadata.
Opening a message with an attachment and showing the hydrated local attachment file created from Gmail read access.
If thread view is included in the submitted app surface, mounting with thread projection and opening a thread plus a child message.
Creating or updating a Markdown file under draft/ and showing the resulting unsent Gmail draft in the user's Gmail account.
Editing an existing remote Gmail draft under draft/ and showing the updated unsent draft in the user's Gmail account.
Creating a Markdown file under outbox/ or moving a remote draft to outbox/, pushing after review, and showing the resulting email in Gmail Sent.
least_privilege_notes: gmail.readonly is required because Locality renders inbox, sent, and draft message bodies and attachments metadata as local Markdown.
gmail.metadata is insufficient because Locality displays message bodies, not only labels and headers.
gmail.compose is required because Locality creates and updates Gmail drafts and sends reviewed outbound messages.
Full mailbox, modify, insert/import, add-on current-message, and standalone send scopes are not requested by the runtime OAuth profile and must not be submitted for Gmail verification.
